name: Murat Demir
bio:
Murat’s journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in Bursa, he initially pursued a degree in mechanical engineering. However, a summer job at a local auto body shop ignited a passion for the artistry of paint and finishing. He quickly realized the crucial role paint played, not just in aesthetics, but also in aerodynamic performance and protection against the harsh racing environment. 

He's been with Toyota Gazoo Racing for eight years, starting as a junior technician and steadily working his way up to a specialist role. Murat takes immense pride in his work, meticulously ensuring every surface is flawless. He is known for his unwavering dedication and collaborative spirit, always willing to share his knowledge with younger team members. His ability to perfectly match colors and create durable finishes has earned him the respect of drivers and engineers alike.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Murat is of average height, with a sturdy build honed from years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an almost dangerous point.
Insists on playing traditional Turkish folk music quietly in his workspace.
Has a lucky paint brush he's used for every car since he joined the team.
